goal: 1) Remove Calendar and Pricing from the rail (they live as tabs inside Rules/Settings); redirect their routes. 2) Name the failing section in the ClientsWorkspace error and add a retry button. 3) Fix workspace inline padding with logical properties.

nav_dedup.redirect_Calendar: activeView=Calendar -> sets ?rules=calendar, replaces hash to #Settings, calls setActiveView('Settings')
nav_dedup.redirect_Pricing: activeView=Pricing -> sets ?rules=rate_card, replaces hash to #Settings, calls setActiveView('Settings')

error_naming.changed: failed state from string to array of {en, he} objects (null while loading, [] if all succeeded, non-empty array naming the broken sections)
error_naming.section_names: Reuses VIEW_LABELS[0..3] which match the four Promise.allSettled slots in order: clients, money, campaigns, advertisers
error_naming.retry_button: clients-retry button calls reload() which increments reloadKey
error_naming.css: clients-error changed to flex with space-between; clients-retry button added

workspace_padding.top_bar: Added margin-inline: -24px to bleed to edges; padding-inline: 24px (unchanged content)
workspace_padding.schedule_staleness_banner: Added margin-inline: -24px to bleed; split padding shorthand to padding-block + padding-inline
workspace_padding.responsive_top_bar: Updated responsive override to use margin-inline: -24px + separate padding-block/padding-inline
workspace_padding.logical_properties: All new/changed padding/margin rules use logical properties (padding-inline, margin-inline, padding-block)

build: clean - npm run build produced 0 errors, 3475 modules transformed
